inicio.descripcion: Two-bedroom industrial-style apartment. Explore it in 3D and request your booking. Demo site with rendered images.
inicio.og_descripcion: Explore the apartment in 3D and request your booking. Demo site.
inicio.hero.alt: Living room with an exposed brick wall, a TV on a floating oak console and a leather sofa, with the balcony in the background
inicio.hero.pie: Pictured: the living room, with the balcony in the background
inicio.espacios.living.alt: Cognac leather sofa with an arc lamp, abstract paintings and the kitchen in the background
inicio.espacios.cocina.alt: L-shaped kitchen with charcoal fronts, white tile, oak shelves and cage pendant lights
inicio.espacios.dorm1.alt: Bedroom featuring a king bed with a light upholstered headboard, nightstands and a table lamp
inicio.espacios.dorm2.alt: Bedroom featuring a king bed with a leather headboard and swing-arm reading lights
inicio.espacios.banos.alt: Bathroom with white tile, a concrete sink, black fixtures and a round mirror
inicio.espacios.balcon.alt: Balcony with a glass railing, a bistro table and two folding chairs
inicio.espacios.recibidor.alt: Entryway with an oak bench, a black pipe coat rack and a painting
inicio.espacios.frase: Two bedrooms, each with a king bed and a sliding-door closet.
inicio.materiales.bajada: The same textures from the 3D model that you see in the images and in the tour.
inicio.recorrido.bajada: Walk through the apartment in first person, on a computer or a phone.
inicio.recorrido.maqueta: The complete model, seen from above without the ceiling.
inicio.recorrido.computador.texto: walk with the keyboard (W A S D or the arrow keys) and look around with the mouse.
inicio.recorrido.telefono.texto: walk with the joystick at the bottom left and look around by dragging anywhere else on the screen.
inicio.recorrido.puertas: Doors and the sliding glass door
inicio.recorrido.puertas.texto: open with a click or a tap.
inicio.recorrido.descarga.texto: phones load a version with lighter textures.
inicio.recorrido.nota: Model built from the architectural floor plan, which has no dimensions: the heights and finishes are a proposed design.
inicio.equipo.bajada: What you see in the model, plus what's marked as an example on this demo site.
inicio.equipo.cocina.texto: Cooktop, range hood, oven and refrigerator.
inicio.equipo.lavadora.texto: In an alcove with a folding door.
inicio.equipo.tv.texto: On the floating console in the living room.
inicio.equipo.banos.texto: Each with a bathtub, shower and glass screen.
inicio.equipo.wifi.texto: Example value on this demo site.
inicio.tarifas.bajada: You send a request with your dates and we reply by email to confirm it. Nothing is charged online.
inicio.tarifas.accion.texto: Pick your nights on the calendar and send the request. We'll confirm by email.
inicio.preguntas.imagenes: Are the images photos of the apartment?
inicio.preguntas.imagenes.respuesta: No. They're renders of a 3D model built from the architectural floor plan, which has no dimensions: measurements were inferred with a ± 5% margin, and the heights, furniture and finishes are a proposed design.
inicio.preguntas.confirmar.respuesta: You choose your dates and send the request. It stays pending and holds those nights on the calendar until we reply by email to confirm or decline it.
inicio.preguntas.pago.respuesta: No. The site doesn't ask for or store payment details. The payment method is arranged on confirmation.
inicio.preguntas.donde.respuesta: The address is provided once the booking is confirmed. This is a demo site and doesn't publish the location.
inicio.preguntas.telefono: Does the 3D tour work on a phone?
inicio.preguntas.telefono.respuesta: Yes. On a phone, you walk with the joystick at the bottom left and look around by dragging anywhere else on the screen. It loads a version with lighter textures.
inicio.preguntas.datos: What do you do with my data?
inicio.preguntas.datos.respuesta: It's used only to reply to your request. Details in the

hero.bajada: Two-bedroom industrial-style apartment: concrete, steel and oak, with a bright living room and a balcony. Explore it in 3D in your browser before you book.
espacios.bajada: An open-plan living room and kitchen between two bedrooms, each with a bathroom nearby and a sliding-door closet.
espacio.living.texto: Exposed brick wall, floating oak TV console, leather sofa and arc lamp. Sliding glass door to the balcony.
espacio.cocina.texto: L-shaped, with charcoal fronts, a concrete countertop, a cooktop with a steel range hood, an oven and a refrigerator. Open oak shelves.
espacio.dorm1.texto: 1.80 × 2.00 m king bed with an upholstered headboard, steel and oak nightstands and a sliding-door closet.
espacio.dorm2.texto: King bed with a leather headboard, swing-arm reading lights and a sliding-door closet.
espacio.banos.texto: Bathtub with an exposed-pipe shower and a glass screen, a concrete sink on an oak vanity and a round mirror.
espacio.balcon.texto: Steel bistro table and two oak folding chairs, with a glass railing. You step out through the living room's sliding glass door.
espacio.recibidor.texto: Bench with a shoe shelf and a black pipe coat rack by the front door.
reserva.descripcion: Choose your dates and send a booking request. No online payment: we'll confirm by email.
reserva.bajada: Pick your nights on the calendar and send the request. It stays pending until we confirm by email.
reserva.aviso_sim: Local test mode: availability and submissions are simulated in this browser.
reserva.sin_js: The calendar and the request need JavaScript. Turn it on in your browser and reload the page to choose your dates and book.
reserva.nota: Example amounts. No online payment: we'll confirm by email.
reserva.paso.pendiente.texto: Your request holds those nights while we review it.
reserva.paso.escribimos.texto: We reply by email to confirm it or suggest other dates.
reserva.paso.pago.texto: Once it's confirmed, we arrange payment and send you the address.
reserva.aviso_demo: This is a demo site: use a made-up name and email.
reserva.acepto: I agree to my data being used only to reply to this request
privacidad.bajada: What data the booking request asks for, what it's used for and where it's stored.
privacidad.demo: Demo site: please don't submit real data.
privacidad.que.texto: For a booking request: name, email, dates, number of guests and, if you like, a phone number and a message. We don't ask for or store payment details.
privacidad.para_que.texto: Only to reply to your request and, if it's confirmed, to coordinate your stay. We don't use it for advertising or share it with third parties.
privacidad.donde.texto: In a Supabase database the public has no access to: the site can only create requests and check which nights are taken, without seeing anyone else's data.
privacidad.cuanto.texto: For as long as the demo site runs. You can ask us to delete your request at any time by replying to the confirmation email.
privacidad.cookies.texto: The site doesn't use tracking cookies. The fonts and the 3D viewer are served from this same site.
privacidad.cookies.idioma: If you pick a language in the selector, the site stores the nf_lang cookie with that preference for one year, so it can show you the pages in that language.
no_encontrada.bajada: That page doesn't exist or has moved. From the home page you can see the spaces, the 3D tour and the dates.
tour.descripcion: Explore the Project-roomVR apartment in 3D, on a computer or phone.
tour.plano.lienzo: Floor plan: tap a room to go there
tour.plano.ayuda: Tap a room on the plan to go there.
tour.ayuda.clic.texto: open or close what you're looking at
tour.ayuda.palanca.texto: touch and drag it to walk
tour.ayuda.arrastrar.texto: anywhere else on the screen, to look around
tour.ayuda.toque.texto: on an object, opens or closes it; on the floor, walks you there
tour.ayuda.nota: Model built from a floor plan without dimensions: heights and finishes are inferred, not measured.
tour.inicio.bajada: Two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living room with a balcony and an L-shaped kitchen. Walk around, open doors and drawers, and turn on the lights in each room.
tour.inicio.raton: On a computer: click “Explore”, then use W A S D to walk, the mouse to look around, and E or a click to interact.
tour.inicio.tactil: On a phone: tap “Explore”, use the joystick at the bottom left to walk, and drag anywhere else on the screen to look around. A quick tap opens what you touch or walks you to that spot on the floor.
